Comment.value:
Certain abilities set at 99 to reflect use at will.  Should be equipped with a Fallen Planetar Longsword, which was presented as a gift from a powerful demon to the Fallen Planetar after their fall.  Alignment set at Chaotic Evil, but can be changed to neutral or chaotic evil.  Fallen Planetar's were the generals of the celestial armies which have strayed from the path of good.  They prefer to jump into the fight with their Fallen Planetar Longsword rather then stand back and cast spells.  They were known to help mortals out, but now just slaughter them mercilessly and enjoy hearing the awful screams of slain Celestials.

Note: Male Version with Custom Fallen Planetar Body Armor, Custom Fallen Planetar Helm, and Custom Fallen Planetar Longsword, made specially for Fallen Planetar's (can work for both Males and Females).

value.0: Fallen Planetars have strayed from the inate path of good and with added infernal powers are fierce opponents. They usually lead a vile cause to destroy those whom once were their very brethren, the Celestials.
value.10: Planetars serve as the mighty generals of celestial armies. They aslo help powerfull mortals on missions of good, especialy if they involve battles with fiends.
